name: Model Turnkey: GLM-5.2 EXL3 (4x RTX PRO 6000)
readme: Multi-model OpenAI-compatible Pod using MODEL_PROFILE=glm52-exl3. Deploy this profile on exactly 4x NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB GPUs. Keep /workspace on a volume of at least 450 GB. For the lower-cost one-GPU Qwen3.6 profile, use runpod-template-qwen36.json. Ports 1111 and 8000 use Runpod managed HTTPS for the dashboard and secure API fallback. In a private clone, add DESEC_TOKEN and DESEC_DOMAIN through Runpod Secrets to make port 8443 a direct appliance-TLS route that avoids Runpod proxy's 100-second limit. Add HF_TOKEN with Runpod Secrets.
